A '''battle''' took place during [[25 ABY/Legends|the first year]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dibrook]]. The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] attacked the [[Dibrook Space Station]], but were fought off when the ''[[Heart of Artorias]]'' arrived.

==Prelude==
Sometime before the battle the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] had secretly established a base on the uninhabitable planet Dibrook. They also placed a [[Yammosk]] under the surface.

==Battle==
The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] appeared out of nowhere to attack the [[Dibrook Space Station]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bylsma]] ordered his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to fight back, even though the Yuuzhan Vong had stripped the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] of both the station and the fighters. Even though the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] ship outnumbered the Yuuzhan Vong's they had a hard time fighting without shields. Some of the refugees living on the station were captured during the battle and brought to the surface on [[Dibrook]], where the Yuuzhan Vong had established a base.

The sudden appearance of the ''[[Heart of Artorias]]'', a [[Revolt aboard the Tsam P'ah|captured]] Yuuzhan Vong [[slaveship]], caused some confusion amongst the New Republic command, but when it started firing on the Yuuzhan Vong they quickly realized it was on their side and they ordered their starfighters not to fire on it. With the help of the ''Heart of Artorias'' the Yuuzhan Vong were soon fought off.

==Aftermath==
The ''Heart of Artorias'' connected with the Dibrook Space Station to take on refugees from damaged sections. The ship's commander, [[Kaye Galfridian]], learned that some refugees had been taken to Dibrook by the Yuuzhan Vong. With help from Bylsma, she organized a [[Rescue Mission to Dibrook|rescue mission]].
